entities.name: KRAB-C2H2 protein sequence
observations: The 418-aa query sequence has an N-terminal KRAB domain at residues 5–46 and multiple C2H2 zinc-finger domain hits spanning approximately residues 199–389.
Sequence-derived estimates: molecular mass 49.2 kDa, pI 8.26, and GRAVY −1.03.
Sequence search found near-identical UniProt hits Q6J6I6 and Q969W8 across 43.3% query coverage, but no homolog passed annotation-transfer filters; exact identity and function remain unresolved.
